summary: 21-year-old fell into Adams Falls in Rocky Mountain National Park and was found deceased; body recovered that evening; helitack to Upper Beaver Meadows; transferred to the Larimer County Coroner per report.
location: Adams Falls, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Adams Falls is west-side/Grand Lake area; compendium reports Larimer County Coroner — discrepancy flagged, county kept per source. Merged run 720: RMNP-day-hikes writeup confirms 2022-05-19 Adams Falls fatality (21yo female, East Inlet Trail west side; Grand County SO/EMS/SAR + Grand Lake Fire assisted).
